profile_text.body:
Meta is a public company founded in 2004 and headquartered in Menlo Park, CA, traded on public markets under the ticker META. Its llama.com site presents the company primarily as a platform for AI developers, offering models and tools under the Muse product line alongside the Meta Model API. The site describes Muse Spark as a coding-optimized model built for writing, reviewing, and shipping code with lower latency, and notes that Muse Spark 1.2 runs through Muse Code, a coding agent built specifically for it. Muse Image is available through Meta Model API at $0.01 per image and is described as a reasoning model that plans layout before drawing. Muse Glimmer is described as a 30-billion-parameter open model optimized for local agent workflows, small enough to run on a Mac or PC with a single consumer GPU. The Meta Model API is noted as compatible with existing OpenAI SDK clients and supports features such as search grounding for real-time web access.

The site's tracked AI product is Llama, an open-weight model family often self-hosted. Several third-party MCP servers connect to Meta's advertising infrastructure, covering campaign management, creative testing, and performance analysis across Facebook and Instagram. Meta reported revenue of $200,966,000,000 for the period ending December 31, 2025, per its most recent 10-K filing, with SEC records held under CIK 0001326801.

Meta faces litigation on multiple fronts. The cases on record include Kadrey v. Meta Platforms, Inc. and Chicken Soup for the Soul, LLC v. Meta Platforms Inc., both in the Northern District of California, as well as Neural AI, LLC v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the Western District of Texas. The held facts also reflect 161 points of legal exposure associated with California.
